mapper.select: SELECT e.id, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, u.id AS unit_id, u.name AS unit_name, p.id AS position_id, p.name AS position_name, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.email, e.phone, e.dob, NULL AS null_col FROM employees e LEFT JOIN units u ON u.id = e.unit_id LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.id = e.position_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = u.company_id WHERE e.id = #{id}

mapper.update: UPDATE employees SET first_name = #{firstName}, last_name = #{lastName}, unit_id = #{unitId}, position_id = #{positionId}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, dob = #{dob} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, c.id AS company_id, c.name AS company_name, u.id AS unit_id, u.name AS unit_name, p.id AS position_id, p.name AS position_name, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.email, e.phone, e.dob, NULL AS null_col FROM employees e LEFT JOIN units u ON u.id = e.unit_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = u.company_id LEFT JOIN positions p ON p.id = e.position_id WHERE LOWER(e.first_name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) OR LOWER(e.last_name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) OR LOWER(e.email) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) OR LOWER(e.phone) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) OR LOWER(u.name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) OR LOWER(p.name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%')) ORDER BY e.id
